How it works

What arrives with me

The instruments, and a short introduction for people who have never done this. Mats and blankets depend on the venue: if yours doesn't have them, people can bring their own. Setup takes thirty minutes, pack-down twenty.

What the room needs

Floor space of roughly two square metres per person, lighting that can be lowered, and a door that closes. Carpet is a bonus, not a requirement.

How it's described to your team

As an hour of listening. Attendance is always optional, no one is asked to speak, and the session makes no claims about health or performance.

Questions before you ask internally?

Logistics, accessibility, what to tell people who are unsure — all answered on the FAQ page.
